reviews.review: Great game for multiplayer and singleplayer if you spend days at a time on your own scenarios you will play once and only once before repeating the process.

This game is just bad. I tried so hard to like it bc ive only heard good things but everything about it is just janky something as simple as using the ADS is bizzare and zooms instead. I was ready for some Call of Duty style combat but the missions lasts like 5 minutes and whole time is spent trying to catch up to your teammates running towards a target only for the squad to take them all out by the time I get there. The controls are some of the worst ive seen in all of gaming like trying to drive that UAV thing I swear ive never been so frustrated trying play a game. Then on top of that you changing any of the key bindings requires a programmer. Like it has so many different unused features that it uses almost every key on a modern keyboard so if you change one thing it screws up everything else plus you cant change the key bindings for character movement!!! like wtf who does this. Im glad i bought this on sale bc if i purchased it full price id def want a refund.

As my first game i have bought on steam (yet) i sunk 12 hours into it in a couple of days, so far i have played modded antistasi and it has been really fun i tried to play some official but it did not work for some reason (might be user error) i cant say much on the multiplayer only that getting into a server that is full and also is nice to play on is quite hard i got this when it was on sale for 6 euro so it was worth it but i am not sure if would have gotten it for 28 euro right now i am looking for a unit to play with as that was what i found one of the more popular ways to play, so far my search has bore no fruit but i remain positive, i for the time will keep enjoying the singleplayer i would recommend to buy it on sale if you are buying without the dlc ( which i do not own any) but there are plenty of user made mods that can still very much satisfy the need for more content, so yes i recommend this game
